# versions { #crossrepo.versions }

```python
crossrepo.versions(
    entry_or_repo,
    filename=None,
    *,
    refresh=False,
    progress=True,
    cfg=None,
)
```

Tabulate the history of one published file or dataset.

The python side of ``crossrepo versions``. These are the commits in which the
file itself changed, which is the useful set to pin; the catalog stamps a
file with the repository's current commit instead.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**entry_or_repo**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository name, optionally ``owner/repo``, or an [](`crossrepo.model.Entry`) already in hand.

<code>[**filename**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   File name, or as much of the path as is unambiguous. Omitted when an entry was given.

<code>[**refresh**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Rescan before resolving, rather than using the stored catalog.

<code>[**progress**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [True]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Show a progress bar while rescanning, one step per repository, as [](`crossrepo.list`) and [](`crossrepo.refresh`) do. Nothing is drawn when the stored catalog is read, and nothing when an [](`crossrepo.model.Entry`) was given, there being no catalog to read.

<code>[**cfg**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Settings. Defaults to [](`crossrepo.config.active_config`): what [](`crossrepo.config.use_config`) registered, or the configuration file.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A `Table`, which is a [](`pandas.DataFrame`), with columns ``version``, ``date``, ``bytes``, ``parts``, ``tags`` and ``subject``, newest first. ``crossrepo.core`` holds a ``versions`` taking an entry and returning [](`crossrepo.model.Version`) objects, which is what this tabulates.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ImportError](`ImportError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If pandas is not installed.

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[LookupError](`LookupError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If nothing matches, or several files do.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
crossrepo.versions("x-gwas", "hits.csv")
```
